recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Pots
recipes.description: Small chilled chocolate desserts with a pinch of sea salt.

steps.text: Chop the chocolate and place it in a heatproof bowl. Warm the cream and milk until steaming.
Pour the hot cream mixture over the chocolate. Let it sit, then stir until smooth.
Divide between small ramekins. Chill for at least two hours and finish with sea salt.

recipes.notes: This recipe makes four small servings.
